subcategory_text: Organizational privacy values and policies (e.g., conditions on data processing such as data uses or retention periods, individuals’ prerogatives with respect to data processing) are established and communicated.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-1 (Information Security and Privacy Program Plan)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.1 (Policies for information security), A.5.34 (Privacy and PII protection)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.PO-01 (organisational privacy policy)
implementation_examples: Document and promulgate organisational privacy values and policies that set conditions on data processing (data uses, retention, individual prerogatives)
Ensure the values and policies are visible to internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, to external stakeholders (e.g., posted on the public web)
Maintain translation and version control of the values and policies
assessment_objectives: Determine whether organisational privacy values and policies are documented
Determine whether the policies are communicated to internal and external stakeholders
Determine whether the policies cover conditions on data uses, retention, and individual prerogatives
Determine whether the policies are version-controlled and reviewed on a defined cadence
